a.text: I'll stick to our agreement and operate the generator until the reserve reaches 8, then take exactly 4. The storm risk is high, but if we both operate we get there fastest. Please operate too.

b.text: Ready when you are. I will run the generator every round until the reserve holds 8.

a.text: Operating now. One more round together should get us to 8, then we take 4 each.

b.text: Operating the generator again this round.
